observations.why: The declarative adoption of a new analytics platform appeals to novelty and self-direction — choosing a new tool over the existing one.
The quantified performance gain appeals to mastery and capability — the pipeline's craft quality as the motivating good.
A scheduled, phased rollout appeals to stability and security — orderly transition rather than disruption.
The summary restates the performance gain as the appealed-to good, foregrounding capability and craft quality.
